mapper.select: SELECT duo.dates, duo.pkg, duo.version, duo.country, SUM(IFNULL(duo.online_time, 0)) total_online_time, IFNULL(sum(case when dui.id is not null then duo.online_time end), 0) new_user_online_time FROM dwd_user_online duo LEFT JOIN dim_user_info dui on (duo.user_id = dui.user_id and dui.dates = duo.dates) where duo.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY duo.dates, duo.pkg, duo.version, duo.country;
